description: A first-draft acting paragraph assembled from the kit and fitted to the target's character cap, already linted. It reads mechanically: rewrite it as prose. A voice target gets the delivery line instead. Paid: $0.10 per call via x402 (USDC on Base), or prepaid credits with an API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>`): 20 for $1.00 with atlas_buy_pack, or by card at https://creatinginai.com/agents#credits.

element.description: Element handle for Elements mode, e.g. @char_noah.

eyeline.description: e.g. 'Mum is off frame LEFT; his eyes go LEFT to her'

modifiers.description: Modifier ids such as exhausted or child (atlas_search with table modifiers).

name.description: Character name as it should appear in the prompt.

shot.description: Shot size, tightest to widest. Default MCU.

state.description: The character's state for one beat. Only feels is required.

alone.description: the private beat after the listener leaves

control.description: Capacity to hold it right now. Default 3.

feels.description: What they feel inside, each with intensity 1-5: a string such as 'fear 4, guilt 3', or a list of {emotion, intensity}.

journey.description: arc stage and what they carry in

reveals.description: Who is present, and what is shown or hidden from them.

because.description: why they hide it, from this person, now

will.description: feelings they are willing to show that person

wont.description: feelings they won't reveal to that person

shows.description: What they show instead: open | deamplify | neutralize | mask-with | amplify | qualify. For mask-with, write 'mask-with:<emotion>' or set with. Default open.

tell.description: Size of the tell: 1 trace, 2 flicker, 3 slip, 4 crack, 5 break. Default: suggested from intensity and control.

with.description: For mask-with: the emotion shown instead.

target.description: Target model id, e.g. kling-omni-single, seedance-2, generic-video, qwen-tts, elevenlabs-v3. See atlas_targets.

name: atlas_draft
title: Scaffold paragraph
